changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, code, description) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'portal.branches.manage', 'Create and rename the owning tenant''s branches. Company-wide roles only.');
INSERT INTO role_permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, role_id, permission_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE r.code = 'executive_director' AND p.code = 'portal.branches.manage';
